description:
Read live Stripe X402 account status: balance, freeze state, pending checkouts, approvals, and recent orders. Use this for a full account overview; do not use to filter delegated keys alone (x402_list_delegate_keys), export statements (x402_export_statement), or quote calls (x402_quote_plan).
Parameters: supply spend_key or x-atlas-spend-key header (mismatch -> HTTP 400); master sees all state, delegate sees own scope.
Behavior: zero charge; master reads poll open Stripe checkouts so settled top-ups appear immediately. HTTP 401 invalid/revoked key, 120 req/min/IP.

spend_key.description: Stripe-funded master or delegated subagent spend key (format: sbk_<43+ chars>). Optional when the caller supplies the x-atlas-spend-key HTTP header.

name: x402_get_account

delegates_active.description: Count of non-revoked delegated subagent keys.

frozen.description: True when the emergency freeze kill switch is currently halting all spends.

key_role.description: Authority tier of the supplied spend key.

ok.description: True when the account snapshot succeeded.

pending_approvals.description: Count of pending single-use escalation tickets awaiting operator decision.

title: Get X402 Account Status
